title: The Header That Shocked Europe

facts.claim: The final was played on 4 July 2004 at the Estádio da Luz in Lisbon.
Charisteas met the corner and sent a powerful header past Ricardo to give Greece the lead.
Greece's German manager Otto Rehhagel became the first person to coach a nation other than his own to European Championship victory.
Before 2004, Greece had qualified for only one European Championship, in 1980.

narration.text: Before this tournament, Greece had reached just one European Championship.
Greece were coached by a German, Otto Rehhagel.
Angelos Charisteas met it with a powerful header.
Greece were champions of Europe. Every goal has a story.
